definition.write: one write-enabled observe pass on sentence 0 produces the fast memory
definition.rebalance: a pre-hook scales the z slice of the generate input by s so its share hits a target
definition.targets: shares 0.05, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8; the same s is used for the k=0 and k=1000 runs
definition.readings: rel_logits and output TV/KL per target share
definition.baseline: share 0.05 must reproduce R44 (dilution < 0.5, rel_logits near 0.033)
definition.confirm: at share 0.5 rel_logits and TV must both be >= 3x the baseline
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy readings on the main subject stay equal before and after

criteria.write: the written fast has abs sum > 0
criteria.baseline: the share-0.05 row reproduces dilution < 0.5 and rel_logits > 0
criteria.monotone: rel_logits and TV are non-decreasing across the four target shares
criteria.confirm: at share 0.5 rel_logits >= 3x baseline and TV >= 3x baseline
criteria.decision: the frozen confirm ratio decides the exit name
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal and the main parameter digest does not move
criteria.rerun: the R44 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
